name: Sweta Rout/ଶ୍ଵେତା ରାଉତ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sweta Rout writes poetry in Odia. Her work has appeared in Odisha Sambad as well as Kabita Live; a 2020 poem in the former bears the same Bhubaneswar contributor location as her early contribution here. Her poems often take the form of an address or an invitation, using questions to test the distance between endurance and freedom.

“Jibana Ta Emiti” begins by asking where disappointment should be directed, then offers images of waiting, dawn, butterflies and an injured bird finding new feathers. Hope remains possible without cancelling suffering. “Chala Pherijiba” is more restless: its invitation to an unnamed planet imagines relief from social pretence and the exhaustion of compliance. Read together, the poems move between making terms with life and imagining a space beyond its imposed conditions.
